name: Being Oppressed
overview: Scripture reveals that being oppressed involves suffering injustice and harm, as illustrated by the man left wounded by thieves in Luke 10:30. God's law in Exodus 22:1 demands restitution for wrongs committed against others, emphasizing accountability and justice. Isaiah 1:17 calls believers to actively seek justice by defending and relieving those who are oppressed, highlighting a divine mandate to care for the vulnerable and uphold righteousness.
